P2-WP003 (sha 292e3243d9bc7a3b88712788a7cb05709eb74eb9) is MEASUREMENT_INVALID (target leakage) and P2-WP003B (sha f6cfdfc749cae9eb4d9fcc4b11b94b63a2bcfb6e) is a bounded mechanics result (action-only MSE 0.756 vs full 0.735, <3% extra variance), neither of which measures barrier state stationarity. allocation.question: On the frozen credential-free HTTP GET pool (extended only if a pre-freeze attainability certificate is satisfied), is an endpoint's intrinsic ACCESS-BARRIER state STATIONARY on the timescales relevant to re-observation scheduling - across separated collection windows and source vantage points, what is the empirical persistence/half-life of each intrinsic class (persistent BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, persistent TRANSPORT_ERROR, transient RATE_LIMIT_429, CLEAN) - and does a static endpoint-level denylist built from window T retain predictive validity at T+delta (false-accept = a denylisted endpoint recovers; false-reject = a previously CLEAN endpoint newly blocks), so that the validity horizon and re-probe interval of the product's dead-end policy are estimable rather than assumed? DESIGN must pre-register a two-sided falsifier (stationary vs non-stationary), a memory/constant null calibrated before freeze with demonstrated power, and a pre-freeze attainability certificate proving both persistently-blocked and recovering/newly-blocking endpoints are reachable across the window pair, and must park if that certificate cannot be satisfied.
allocation.rationale: Physics is IDLE and must be either reactivated or parked; its prior next-request classification subthread returned NO_CONTINUE and the barrier subthread was recorded BOUNDED on the tested pool/window, so the object is materially changed rather than repeated: the unit of study becomes endpoint barrier-state persistence/timescale (a scheduling object) instead of per-request next-state prediction. This has direct product leverage - the validity horizon and re-probe interval of the dead-end/denylist policy - and a computable decision value (should the product re-probe, and how often). It is orthogonal to C-FRESHNESS (staleness of inherited content) and to Runtime drift controls. The gate structure (attainability certificate, two-sided falsifier, calibrated null, capped budget, PARK-on-failure) implements the audit's rule that physics may continue only with predeclared orthogonal decision value and a capped budget, else park. Cognitive reset: with no inherited next_question, physics would test whether observable Web access barriers are a persistent endpoint property or a transient/rate-driven artifact, because that determines whether any endpoint-level policy can be amortized; the inherited handoff proposes exactly this reframing, so it wins on its merits.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: 435 canonical experiments. Five of six lanes carry prefreeze work; physics is IDLE with no mandate. The cumulative audit and the machine snapshot agree on one strategic bottleneck: the flagship inheritance question (C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON) is gated by three readiness conditions - B1 a shipped parameterized-inheritance carrier plus a known-negative refusal (Product/C-PARAM-INHERIT), B2 a task bank with non-ceiling cold/retrieval dynamic range and a real treatment/comparator contrast (Runtime/C-MEAS-VALID), B3 a same-model credential-free endpoint able to drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent test (Intel/C-LLM-INHERIT). Until all three hold, expensive full-benchmark execution is not funded. This cycle therefore endorses the already-mounted blocker-removal mandates for Product (B1) and Runtime (B2), keeps Intel on the cheap, decisive capability-ceiling test (B3), and does not launch the four-arm benchmark. Graph and Frontier keep their prefreeze threads only because each is now a single decisive gate with an explicit PARK branch (construct a >=2-anchor D1V population or park the four-anchor route; certify a DEEP sampling frame pre-freeze or park the discovery question), which is the audit's recommended way to stop two local attractors rather than feed them. The idle physics lane is reactivated on a materially re-scoped object - endpoint access-barrier state persistence/timescale and static-denylist validity horizon - with a hard pre-freeze attainability certificate, a two-sided falsifier, a calibrated memory/constant null and a capped budget; if the certificate cannot be satisfied the lane must PARK rather than spend an EXECUTE cycle. No claim status is upgraded by this allocation; no frozen transaction is disturbed; measurement-invalid and negative evidence is preserved as-is.
